error.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Sign in again to resume your saved progress.
error.LOGIN_CODE_INVALID: That sign-in link is expired or has already been used. Request a new link from your administrator.
error.LOGIN_CODES_DISABLED: One-time sign-in links are turned off here. Sign in with your username and password.
error.LOGIN_FAILED: The username or password is incorrect.
error.LOGIN_THROTTLED: Too many unsuccessful attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
error.AUTH_BUSY: Sign-in is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
error.PASSWORD_POLICY: Use a password of 12 to 1024 characters.
error.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a password different from the current one.
error.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Choose a new password to continue.
error.PASSWORD_NOT_SET: This account has no password yet. Ask your course team to set one.
error.PASSKEY_FAILED: That passkey was not accepted. Sign in with your password, or try another passkey.
error.PASSKEY_CHALLENGE_INVALID: The passkey request expired. Try again.
error.PASSKEY_REGISTRATION_FAILED: The passkey could not be verified. Try again, or use another device.
error.PASSKEY_LIMIT: You have the maximum number of passkeys. Remove one to add another.
error.PASSKEY_NAME_INVALID: Use a passkey name of 1 to 100 characters.
error.PASSKEYS_UNAVAILABLE: Passkeys are not available here. Sign in with your password.
error.REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Enter your current password to add a passkey.
error.STALE_REVISION: Your progress changed on another request or device. Refresh before trying again.
error.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Complete the remaining independent checks below before finishing this lesson.
error.GATE_NOT_READY: This checkpoint is not ready yet. The next steps below say exactly what is still needed.
error.GATE_DECISION_STALE: Your progress changed in another tab or your study plan was updated. The current checkpoint status is shown below; try again from there.
error.GATE_DECISION_UNLINKED: That checkpoint decision does not belong to this lesson. The current status is shown below.
error.GATE_REVIEW_OPEN: You already asked for a review of this checkpoint. A staff member will respond.
error.GATE_REVIEW_WINDOW_CLOSED: The time to ask for a review of this decision has passed. Your saved work and the decision record are kept.
error.GATE_REVIEW_NOT_OFFERED: This checkpoint does not offer a staff review. Ask your course team if you need help.
error.GATE_DECISION_NOT_REVIEWABLE: This checkpoint's current status cannot be reviewed. The current status is shown below.
error.GATE_EXCEPTION_GRANTED: A staff exception already lets you continue past this checkpoint.
error.REVIEW_REASON_REQUIRED: Say in a sentence or two why you would like this decision reviewed.
error.AGENT_AUTHORED_ANSWER: This answer repeats the companion's words. Write it in your own words; nothing was recorded.
error.ABSTAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This check needs an attempt. Share what you can; a partial answer is fine.
error.INVALID_CONFIDENCE: Choose a confidence level from the scale shown, or leave it blank.
error.ASSESSMENT_HELP_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Choose whether to keep your independent attempt or switch it to practice before sending this message.
error.CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: This check has expired. Refresh to get the current check; your saved progress is unchanged.
error.PENDING_CORRUPT: A saved request could not be safely recovered. Contact your course team before making another change.
error.NETWORK_UNCERTAIN: The connection was interrupted. Retry the saved request to confirm whether it was received.
error.COVERAGE_REQUIRED: Finish the reading steps before completing this episode.
error.FRESH_EVIDENCE_ITEM_REQUIRED: This checkpoint needs a new independent question. Your supervisor must prepare and verify one; repeating a revealed answer will not grant credit.
error.DEADLINE_REACHED: This learning window has ended. You can review the closure or any available extension offer.
error.PREREQUISITE_NOT_READY: Finish the current required episode before opening this one.
error.EVALUATOR_NOT_CONFIGURED: The grader is not configured for this exercise yet. Your draft is preserved; no result or credit has been recorded.
error.CODE_EVALUATOR_UNAVAILABLE: The code runner is unavailable or busy. Your draft is preserved and no result has been recorded. Retry the saved request when it is available.
error.CODE_LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This exercise uses a language the current grader cannot run. Your draft is preserved; no result or credit has been recorded.
error.CODE_FIXTURE_NOT_FOUND: The reference checks for this exercise are not configured. Your draft is preserved; contact your course team.
error.INVALID_CODE_SUBMISSION: The grader could not accept this source. Use Python and keep the solution within 64,000 UTF-8 bytes. Your draft is preserved.
error.STALE_POLICY_REVISION: Your study plan changed. Refresh its dates and review the current offer before deciding.
error.STALE_OFFER: This offer is no longer current. Refresh and review updated terms before accepting.
error.TERMS_CHANGED: The offer terms or remaining allowance changed. Review a refreshed offer before accepting.
error.OFFER_EXPIRED: This extension offer has expired. Your current dates have not been extended.
error.INVALID_OFFER_STATE: This offer no longer needs a decision. Refresh to see its current status.
error.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Review the offer and explicitly accept its terms before continuing.
error.ACCESS_CLOSED: This material is no longer available under the course access policy.
error.HELP_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: You have used every question this closed course allows. Your saved conversation and course material stay available to read.
error.PENDING_UNCERTAIN: A previous request has not been confirmed. Retry that request before sending a different change.
error.generic: The request could not be completed. Your saved progress has been preserved.
error.ADAPTATION_NOT_AT_SAFE_BOUNDARY: Finish the question or activity you are working on first. The new material is added after that, so nothing you are doing changes under you.
error.PENDING_CHANGE_RESOLVED: This addition was already added, turned down or is no longer available. Refresh to see your lesson as it is now.
error.READ_TIMEOUT: The server took too long to answer. Nothing was changed; check your connection and try again.
